messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] How to identify tissue specific DMR
parts:
I guess best way to tackle would be to add the tissue as a covariate which you can not do currently in methylKit. 

You can do test vs control for tissue 1, and test vs control for tissue2 and overlap them to get the tissue specific effect. 

then do tissue1 vs tissue 2 for test samples and tissue1 vs tissue2 for control samples.
